nodes.summary: There exist natural numbers $e$ and $r$ and a finite $2$-group $P$ of exponent $2^e$ in which every abelian subgroup is generated by at most $r$ elements, such that $|P| > 2^{r(e+1)}$.
nodes.title: Sambale's order bound for $2$-groups of bounded abelian rank fails (Kourovka 19.75)

nodes.summary: The statement that for all natural numbers $e$ and $r$, every finite $2$-group $P$ of exponent $2^e$ in which every abelian subgroup is generated by at most $r$ elements has order $|P| \le 2^{r(e+1)}$.
nodes.title: Sambale's question on the order of $2$-groups of bounded abelian rank (Kourovka 19.75)
